title: The last three days, in order, with the usage numbers explained

owner_note.text: You asked for an overview from your last check-in to now. It is one page: your four Friday asks and what each became, then Saturday and Sunday day by day, the four things waiting on you, and what "13.8 points under" means (54% of the weekly limit used against 67.8% of the week gone).
